ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 晚上好！我们是一家Dumb Rock！！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
……我真庆幸拥有这么好的Family啊……
谢谢你们

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 这就是『Family』

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ——『Family就该和睦』！！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 因为这就是Family！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 今晚也要尽情释放充满爱与和睦的旋律！！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 这把吉他，满载着爱呢

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
然后，我是吉他兼主唱须贺蕾叶！
大家都是吉他手，请多关照啦

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
再次介绍一下，我是蕾叶，
这位是我的Family，心玖

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 各位，谢谢你们和我一起演出！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 大家～～！吃饭的时间到了哦～！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我拿棒棒冰来了哦～！今天吃哪种？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 来吧，今天也像Family一样玩乐队吧！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 快看，樱花开了哦！大家一起去赏花吧！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 为了做散寿司，我准备了超——多的醋饭哦！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 各位——想去海边还是去游泳池？去河边也可以哦！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 千梨～！和我一起分吃棒棒冰吧！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 大家送了我好多团子，说是让我们一起去赏月！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 附近的小孩们邀请我去挖红薯了～

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 各位！积雪了！去院子里打雪仗吧！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 宁月在被炉里睡着了……！要小声一点……！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 今天我要为了Family变成圣诞老人♪

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 新年好～！好了，我们Family一起去新年参拜吧～！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我要给Family做一个超大的心形巧克力～！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 谢谢～！收到Family的祝福最开心了！

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_025
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 心玖生日快乐～！哎呀呀，害羞了？很开心吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_026
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 蓬咲，你今天是寿星所以坐到中间来！
